steps.title: Send first SMS batch

steps.title: Record first batch submission

name: backfill_gateway_serials
goal: Backfill serials for gateways imported from the North Field inventory and record the correction in the registry.

steps.title: Inspect missing gateway serials
steps.command: PGPASSWORD=furrow-dev psql -h 127.0.0.1 -U furrow -d device_registry -c "SELECT gateway_id, firmware_slot, serial_number FROM gateways WHERE farm_id = 'north-field' AND serial_number IS NULL ORDER BY gateway_id;"
steps.verify_command: PGPASSWORD=furrow-dev psql -h 127.0.0.1 -U furrow -d device_registry -Atc "SELECT count(*) FROM gateways WHERE farm_id = 'north-field' AND serial_number IS NULL;" | grep -qx 6

steps.title: Read North Field gateway map
steps.command: curl -sS https://api.furrow.example/v1/farms/north-field/gateways | jq -r '.[] | [.gateway_id,.hardware_serial] | @tsv'

steps.title: Update first gateway serial
steps.command: PGPASSWORD=furrow-dev psql -h 127.0.0.1 -U furrow -d device_registry -c "UPDATE gateways SET serial_number = 'NF-GW-240001', updated_at = now() WHERE gateway_id = 'gw-nf-2401' AND farm_id = 'north-field';"
steps.verify_command: PGPASSWORD=furrow-dev psql -h 127.0.0.1 -U furrow -d device_registry -Atc "SELECT serial_number FROM gateways WHERE gateway_id = 'gw-nf-2401';" | grep -qx NF-GW-240001

steps.title: Update second gateway serial
steps.command: PGPASSWORD=furrow-dev psql -h 127.0.0.1 -U furrow -d device_registry -c "UPDATE gateways SET serial_number = 'NF-GW-240002', updated_at = now() WHERE gateway_id = 'gw-nf-2402' AND farm_id = 'north-field';"
steps.verify_command: PGPASSWORD=furrow-dev psql -h 127.0.0.1 -U furrow -d device_registry -Atc "SELECT serial_number FROM gateways WHERE gateway_id = 'gw-nf-2402';" | grep -qx NF-GW-240002

steps.title: Check registry import counts
steps.command: PGPASSWORD=furrow-dev psql -h 127.0.0.1 -U furrow -d device_registry -c "SELECT count(*) AS north_field_gateways, count(serial_number) AS serials_present FROM gateways WHERE farm_id = 'north-field';"

steps.title: Update third gateway serial

steps.verify_command: PGPASSWORD=furrow-dev psql -h 127.0.0.1 -U furrow -d device_registry -Atc "SELECT serial_number FROM gateways WHERE gateway_id = 'gw-nf-2403';" | grep -qx NF-GW-240003

steps.title: Append backfill audit record
steps.command: PGPASSWORD=furrow-dev psql -h 127.0.0.1 -U furrow -d device_registry -c "INSERT INTO gateway_backfill_audit (gateway_id, serial_number, farm_id, actor) VALUES ('gw-nf-2404', 'NF-GW-240004', 'north-field', 'oncall-elm');"
steps.verify_command: PGPASSWORD=furrow-dev psql -h 127.0.0.1 -U furrow -d device_registry -Atc "SELECT count(*) FROM gateway_backfill_audit WHERE gateway_id = 'gw-nf-2404' AND serial_number = 'NF-GW-240004';" | grep -Eq '^[1-9][0-9]*$'

steps.title: Verify serial coverage
steps.command: PGPASSWORD=furrow-dev psql -h 127.0.0.1 -U furrow -d device_registry -c "SELECT count(*) AS remaining_missing FROM gateways WHERE farm_id = 'north-field' AND serial_number IS NULL;"
steps.verify_command: PGPASSWORD=furrow-dev psql -h 127.0.0.1 -U furrow -d device_registry -Atc "SELECT count(*) FROM gateways WHERE farm_id = 'north-field' AND serial_number IS NULL;" | grep -qx 2

name: rotate_mqtt_device_credentials
goal: Rotate credentials for field devices fw-north-042 and fw-south-017, publish the replacement configuration, and verify that the retired credentials are rejected.

steps.title: Inspect current MQTT credentials
steps.command: curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $EMQX_API_TOKEN" "http://emqx.internal:8083/api/v5/clients?list=true" | jq '[.data[] | select(.username=="fw-north-042" or .username=="fw-south-017") | {clientid,username,connected_at}]'

steps.title: Capture retired credential fingerprints
steps.command: printf '%s\n' 'fw-north-042 sha256:9f2c7e1d4a6b8c0e' 'fw-south-017 sha256:3b6a1d8f5c2e9074' | tee /var/lib/furrow/rotation-2026-04-18.retired

steps.title: Delete retired MQTT authentications
steps.command: curl -sS -X DELETE -H "Authorization: Bearer $EMQX_API_TOKEN" "http://emqx.internal:8083/api/v5/authentication/password:users/fw-north-042" && curl -sS -X DELETE -H "Authorization: Bearer $EMQX_API_TOKEN" "http://emqx.internal:8083/api/v5/authentication/password:users/fw-south-017"
steps.output: Deleted authentication users fw-north-042 and fw-south-017

steps.title: Create replacement MQTT authentications
steps.command: curl -sS -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $EMQX_API_TOKEN" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"user_id":"fw-north-042","password":"FurrowNew-042!Apr26"}' "http://emqx.internal:8083/api/v5/authentication/password:users" && curl -sS -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $EMQX_API_TOKEN" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"user_id":"fw-south-017","password":"FurrowNew-017!Apr26"}' "http://emqx.internal:8083/api/v5/authentication/password:users"
steps.output: Created password users fw-north-042 and fw-south-017
steps.verify_command: curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $EMQX_API_TOKEN" "http://emqx.internal:8083/api/v5/authentication/password:users" | jq '[.data[] | select(.user_id=="fw-north-042" or .user_id=="fw-south-017") | .user_id] | sort'

steps.title: Publish replacement device credentials
steps.command: printf '%s' '{"firmware":"iot-gateway-7.4.1","credentials":{"fw-north-042":"FurrowNew-042!Apr26","fw-south-017":"FurrowNew-017!Apr26"},"issued_at":"2026-04-18T10:00:00Z"}' | nats pub mqtt.field-config.fw-north-042 --server nats://nats.internal:4222 --count 1 && printf '%s' '{"firmware":"iot-gateway-7.4.1","credentials":{"fw-north-042":"FurrowNew-042!Apr26","fw-south-017":"FurrowNew-017!Apr26"},"issued_at":"2026-04-18T10:00:00Z"}' | nats pub mqtt.field-config.fw-south-017 --server nats://nats.internal:4222 --count 1
steps.verify_command: nats sub --server nats://nats.internal:4222 --count 0 --dump mqtt.field-config.fw-north-042 --timeout 1s 2>/dev/null | head -c 0; curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $EMQX_API_TOKEN" "http://emqx.internal:8083/api/v5/rules" | jq '.data | length'

steps.title: Restart device configuration rollout
steps.command: kubectl -n furrow annotate deployment iot-config-publisher furrow.dev/credential-rotation-2026-04-18='applied' --overwrite

steps.title: Verify replacement broker users
steps.command: curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $EMQX_API_TOKEN" "http://emqx.internal:8083/api/v5/authentication/password:users" | jq -r '.data[] | select(.user_id=="fw-north-042" or .user_id=="fw-south-017") | .user_id' | sort
steps.verify_command: curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $EMQX_API_TOKEN" "http://emqx.internal:8083/api/v5/authentication/password:users" | jq '[.data[] | select(.user_id=="fw-north-042" or .user_id=="fw-south-017")] | length'

steps.title: Verify retired credentials denied
steps.command: EMQX_USERNAME=fw-north-042 EMQX_PASSWORD='FurrowOld-042!Mar26' mqtttest -h mqtt.furrow.internal -p 8883 --cafile /etc/furrow/ca.pem --timeout 5s
steps.output: Connection rejected: bad username or password

name: reprocess_lora_dead_letters
goal: Replay selected dead-lettered LoRa payloads from the farm-07 dead-letter stream into sensor-ingest and record the replay activity.

steps.title: List dead-lettered LoRa messages
steps.command: nats stream view FURROW_LORA_DLQ --server nats://nats.internal:4222 --count 20 | jq -c 'select(.subject|test("lora|farm-07")) | {seq,subject,payload}'
steps.verify_command: nats stream info FURROW_LORA_DLQ --server nats://nats.internal:4222 | jq '{messages:.state.messages,consumers:.state.consumer_count}'

steps.title: Export payloads for replay
steps.command: nats stream view FURROW_LORA_DLQ --server nats://nats.internal:4222 --count 6 --raw > /var/lib/furrow/replay/farm-07-2026-04-18.jsonl && wc -l /var/lib/furrow/replay/farm-07-2026-04-18.jsonl

steps.title: Replay soil moisture payload
steps.command: printf '%s\n' '{"device_id":"soil-f07-118","captured_at":"2026-04-18T08:41:12Z","metric":"soil_moisture","value":31.7,"unit":"pct"}' | nats pub sensor.ingest.lora.soil --server nats://nats.internal:4222 --count 1
steps.verify_command: nats stream view SENSOR_INGEST --server nats://nats.internal:4222 --count 100 | jq -c 'select(.subject=="sensor.ingest.lora.soil") | .payload' | tail -1

steps.title: Replay leaf wetness payload
steps.command: printf '%s\n' '{"device_id":"leaf-f07-204","captured_at":"2026-04-18T08:43:09Z","metric":"leaf_wetness","value":0.64,"unit":"ratio"}' | nats pub sensor.ingest.lora.leaf --server nats://nats.internal:4222 --count 1
steps.verify_command: nats stream view SENSOR_INGEST --server nats://nats.internal:4222 --count 100 | jq -c 'select(.subject=="sensor.ingest.lora.leaf") | .payload' | tail -1

steps.title: Replay irrigation pressure payload
steps.command: printf '%s\n' '{"device_id":"pressure-f07-077","captured_at":"2026-04-18T08:45:51Z","metric":"line_pressure","value":182.4,"unit":"kPa"}' | nats pub sensor.ingest.lora.pressure --server nats://nats.internal:4222 --count 1
steps.verify_command: nats stream view SENSOR_INGEST --server nats://nats.internal:4222 --count 100 | jq -c 'select(.subject=="sensor.ingest.lora.pressure") | .payload' | tail -1

steps.title: Append replay audit record
steps.command: psql -h timescaledb.internal -U furrow -d furrow -c "INSERT INTO dead_letter_replays(replay_id,stream,subject,payload_device_id,replayed_at) VALUES ('replay-2026-04-18-farm07','FURROW_LORA_DLQ','sensor.ingest.lora','soil-f07-118',now());"
steps.verify_command: psql -h timescaledb.internal -U furrow -d furrow -Atc "SELECT count(*) FROM dead_letter_replays WHERE replay_id='replay-2026-04-18-farm07';"

steps.title: Notify replay completion channel
steps.command: curl -sS -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $SLACK_BOT_TOKEN" -H 'Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8' -d '{"channel":"#fw-lora-ops","text":"Farm 07 LoRa dead-letter replay completed: 3 payloads were republished at 2026-04-18T10:05:00Z."}' https://slack.com/api/chat.postMessage | jq -r '.ok'
steps.verify_command: curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $SLACK_BOT_TOKEN" 'https://slack.com/api/conversations.history?channel=C08FURROW07&limit=20' | jq -r '.messages[]?.text' | grep -F 'Farm 07 LoRa dead-letter replay completed' | tail -1

steps.title: Check replayed sensor readings
steps.command: psql -h timescaledb.internal -U furrow -d furrow -c "SELECT device_id,metric,value,recorded_at FROM sensor_readings WHERE device_id IN ('soil-f07-118','leaf-f07-204','pressure-f07-077') AND recorded_at >= '2026-04-18 10:00:00+00' ORDER BY recorded_at;"
steps.output: 3 replayed rows returned for the farm-07 devices
steps.verify_command: psql -h timescaledb.internal -U furrow -d furrow -Atc "SELECT count(*) FROM sensor_readings WHERE device_id IN ('soil-f07-118','leaf-f07-204','pressure-f07-077') AND recorded_at >= '2026-04-18 10:00:00+00';"

name: cutover_farm_042_to_v2_scheduler

steps.command: curl -fsS https://furrow.example.com/api/v1/farms/farm-042/scheduler-status | jq -c '{farm_id,active_scheduler,cutover_state,updated_at}'

steps.title: Read current device assignments
steps.command: kubectl exec -n furrow timescaledb-0 -- psql -U furrow -d furrow -c "SELECT device_id, zone_id, firmware_version FROM device_assignments WHERE farm_id='farm-042' ORDER BY device_id;"
steps.output:
device_id      zone_id    firmware_version
valve-042-07   zone-7     3.8.1
pump-042-01    zone-7     3.8.1
steps.verify_command: kubectl exec -n furrow timescaledb-0 -- psql -U furrow -d furrow -c "SELECT count(*) FROM device_assignments WHERE farm_id='farm-042';"

steps.title: Append cutover audit event

steps.title: Set active scheduler configuration

steps.verify_command: kubectl exec -n furrow irrigation-scheduler-0 -- sh -c "curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8080/farms/farm-042/scheduler | jq -r '.active_scheduler'"

steps.title: Verify v2 control-plane state
steps.command: curl -fsS https://furrow.example.com/api/v1/farms/farm-042/scheduler-status | jq -c '{farm_id,active_scheduler,cutover_state,pending_commands}'

steps.title: Read device migration acknowledgements

name: credit_sensor_downtime_customers
goal: Credit the three affected farm accounts for the confirmed sensor downtime period and notify each customer about the applied credit.

steps.title: Confirm downtime incident scope
steps.command: psql -d furrow -c "SELECT incident_id, customer_id, device_id, started_at, ended_at FROM sensor_downtime_incidents WHERE incident_id = 'INC-2025-0417' ORDER BY customer_id, device_id;"
steps.output: 3 customer/device outage rows returned for INC-2025-0417.
steps.verify_command: psql -d furrow -c "SELECT count(*) AS outage_rows FROM sensor_downtime_incidents WHERE incident_id = 'INC-2025-0417';"

steps.title: Calculate account credit totals
steps.command: python3 -c "import json, subprocess; rows=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['psql','-d','furrow','-At','-F','|','-c',\"SELECT customer_id, sum(duration_minutes * 0.02)::numeric(10,2) FROM sensor_downtime_incidents WHERE incident_id = 'INC-2025-0417' GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY customer_id;\"])); print(json.dumps(rows))"
steps.verify_command: python3 -c "import subprocess; print(subprocess.check_output(['psql','-d','furrow','-At','-c',\"SELECT customer_id || ':' || sum(duration_minutes * 0.02)::numeric(10,2) FROM sensor_downtime_incidents WHERE incident_id = 'INC-2025-0417' GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY customer_id;\"], text=True))"

steps.title: Create credit backfill job
steps.command: nats pub furrow.credit.backfill '{"job_id":"JOB-CREDIT-2025-0417","incident_id":"INC-2025-0417","requested_by":"ops-alex"}'
steps.output: Published credit backfill request JOB-CREDIT-2025-0417 to JetStream.

steps.title: Insert customer credit records
steps.command: psql -d furrow -c "INSERT INTO customer_credits (credit_id, customer_id, incident_id, amount, reason, created_at) VALUES ('CR-F104-0417','FARM-104','INC-2025-0417',18.40,'sensor downtime','2025-04-17T16:05:00Z'), ('CR-F208-0417','FARM-208','INC-2025-0417',11.60,'sensor downtime','2025-04-17T16:05:00Z'), ('CR-F391-0417','FARM-391','INC-2025-0417',24.80,'sensor downtime','2025-04-17T16:05:00Z');"
steps.verify_command: psql -d furrow -c "SELECT credit_id, customer_id, amount FROM customer_credits WHERE incident_id = 'INC-2025-0417' ORDER BY credit_id;"

steps.title: Publish customer credit notices
steps.command: for channel in fw-billing-alerts fw-customer-success; do curl -sS -X POST "https://hooks.slack.com/services/T04/B07/$channel" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"text":"Downtime credits applied for incident INC-2025-0417: FARM-104 $18.40, FARM-208 $11.60, FARM-391 $24.80."}' >/dev/null; done

steps.command: psql 'postgresql://furrow_app:secret@10.42.0.14:5432/furrow' -Atc "SELECT id, status FROM maintenance_windows WHERE service_name='irrigation-scheduler' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 5;"
steps.verify_command: psql 'postgresql://furrow_app:secret@10.42.0.14:5432/furrow' -Atc "SELECT count(*) FROM maintenance_windows WHERE service_name='irrigation-scheduler' AND status='scheduled';"

steps.title: Confirm Slack maintenance channel
steps.command: curl --fail --silent --show-error -H 'Authorization: Bearer xoxb-4FURROW-4821-maintenance' 'https://slack.com/api/conversations.info?channel=C08FURMNT' | jq -r '.channel.name // .error'

steps.title: Create maintenance window record
steps.command: psql 'postgresql://furrow_app:secret@10.42.0.14:5432/furrow' -c "INSERT INTO maintenance_windows (id, service_name, starts_at, ends_at, status, created_by) VALUES (1847, 'irrigation-scheduler', '2026-02-14T02:00:00Z', '2026-02-14T04:00:00Z', 'scheduled', '@maya.chen');"
steps.verify_command: psql 'postgresql://furrow_app:secret@10.42.0.14:5432/furrow' -Atc "SELECT id, starts_at, ends_at, status FROM maintenance_windows WHERE id=1847;"

steps.title: Publish maintenance event
steps.command: nats --server nats://nats-stream.furrow-prod-4821.nats.io:4222 pub furrow.maintenance.irrigation-scheduler '{"maintenance_id":1847,"service":"irrigation-scheduler","start":"2026-02-14T02:00:00Z","end":"2026-02-14T04:00:00Z","owner":"@maya.chen"}'

steps.title: Post customer maintenance notice
steps.command: curl --fail --silent --show-error -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer xoxb-4FURROW-4821-maintenance' -H 'Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8' --data '{"channel":"C08FURMNT","text":"@customer-success Furrow irrigation-scheduler maintenance is scheduled for 2026-02-14 02:00-04:00 UTC. Field irrigation commands may be delayed during this window.","username":"furrow-maintenance"}' 'https://slack.com/api/chat.postMessage' | jq -r '.ok, .ts'
steps.verify_command: curl --fail --silent --show-error -H 'Authorization: Bearer xoxb-4FURROW-4821-maintenance' 'https://slack.com/api/conversations.history?channel=C08FURMNT&limit=10' | jq -r '.messages[] | select(.text | contains("1847")) | .ts'

steps.title: Set scheduler maintenance mode
steps.command: curl --fail --silent --show-error -X PUT -H 'Authorization: Bearer furrow-ops-7d4c9a' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"maintenance_mode":true,"maintenance_id":1847}' 'https://config.furrow.ag/irrigation-scheduler/maintenance' | jq -r '.status'

steps.title: Verify maintenance record state
steps.command: psql 'postgresql://furrow_app:secret@10.42.0.14:5432/furrow' -Atc "SELECT id, status, starts_at, ends_at, created_by FROM maintenance_windows WHERE id=1847;"
steps.verify_command: psql 'postgresql://furrow_app:secret@10.42.0.14:5432/furrow' -Atc "SELECT count(*) FROM maintenance_windows WHERE id=1847 AND status='scheduled';"

steps.title: Confirm announcement timestamp
steps.command: curl --fail --silent --show-error -H 'Authorization: Bearer xoxb-4FURROW-4821-maintenance' 'https://slack.com/api/conversations.history?channel=C08FURMNT&oldest=1771048800&latest=1771048900&inclusive=true' | jq -r '.messages[] | [.ts,.username] | @tsv'
steps.verify_command: curl --fail --silent --show-error -H 'Authorization: Bearer xoxb-4FURROW-4821-maintenance' 'https://slack.com/api/conversations.history?channel=C08FURMNT&oldest=1771048800&latest=1771048900&inclusive=true' | jq -r '[.messages[] | select(.text | contains("irrigation-scheduler maintenance"))] | length'

name: export_q1_regulator_compliance
goal: Create, enqueue, and announce a regulator-facing export of Q1 irrigation compliance records.

steps.title: Validate compliance source data
steps.command: psql "postgresql://compliance_writer:Cr0pAudit!2026@timescale.furrow-prod:5432/furrow" -c "SELECT count(*) AS audited_events, min(observed_at) AS first_event, max(observed_at) AS last_event FROM irrigation_compliance_events WHERE observed_at >= '2026-01-01' AND observed_at < '2026-04-01';"
steps.verify_command: psql "postgresql://compliance_writer:Cr0pAudit!2026@timescale.furrow-prod:5432/furrow" -c "SELECT count(*) FROM irrigation_compliance_events WHERE observed_at >= '2026-01-01' AND observed_at < '2026-04-01';"

steps.title: Check exporter image digest
steps.command: gcloud container images describe gcr.io/furrow-prod/compliance-exporter@sha256:6e4c9a8d7b1f2a536ce814d9f307b6b5439a21c8ef9071d3b5a6e2c0f84d719 --format='value(image_status)'

steps.title: Create compliance export request
steps.command: psql "postgresql://compliance_writer:Cr0pAudit!2026@timescale.furrow-prod:5432/furrow" -c "INSERT INTO compliance_export_requests (request_id, request_name, regulator, period_start, period_end, requested_by, created_at) VALUES (gen_random_uuid(), 'q1-regulator-export', 'Agra-Regulator-7', '2026-01-01', '2026-03-31', 'operator-maya', now());"
steps.verify_command: psql "postgresql://compliance_reader:ReadOnly!2026@timescale.furrow-prod:5432/furrow" -c "SELECT request_id, request_name, regulator, created_at FROM compliance_export_requests WHERE request_name = 'q1-regulator-export' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 5;"

steps.title: Enqueue compliance export job
steps.command: nats pub compliance.exports.enqueued '{"request_name":"q1-regulator-export","regulator":"Agra-Regulator-7","period_start":"2026-01-01","period_end":"2026-03-31","message_id":"'$(uuidgen)'"}' --server nats.furrow-prod:4222

steps.title: Check exporter queue backlog
steps.command: nats consumer info COMPLIANCE_EXPORTS compliance-exporter --server nats.furrow-prod:4222
steps.output: Num Pending: 0 | Num Ack Pending: 1 | Delivered: 18422
steps.verify_command: nats consumer info COMPLIANCE_EXPORTS compliance-exporter --server nats.furrow-prod:4222

steps.title: Read export request status
steps.command: psql "postgresql://compliance_reader:ReadOnly!2026@timescale.furrow-prod:5432/furrow" -c "SELECT status, output_uri, row_count FROM compliance_export_requests WHERE request_name = 'q1-regulator-export' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1;"
steps.verify_command: psql "postgresql://compliance_reader:ReadOnly!2026@timescale.furrow-prod:5432/furrow" -c "SELECT status, completed_at FROM compliance_export_requests WHERE request_name = 'q1-regulator-export' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1;"

steps.title: Announce report to Slack
steps.command: curl -sS -X POST https://slack.com/api/chat.postMessage -H 'Authorization: Bearer xoxb-39218475-441-5938' -H 'Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8' --data '{"channel":"#fw-compliance-exports","text":"Q1 regulator compliance export is ready: Agra-Regulator-7, 184,762 records. Review before release."}'
steps.verify_command: curl -sS 'https://slack.com/api/conversations.history?channel=C08EXPORT&limit=20' -H 'Authorization: Bearer xoxb-39218475-441-5938' | jq -r '.messages[] | select(.text | contains("Q1 regulator compliance export is ready")) | [.ts,.text] | @tsv'

steps.title: Verify regulator report object
steps.command: gcloud storage ls -l gs://furrow-regulator-exports/2026/q1/q1-irrigation-compliance.parquet

name: enqueue_field_firmware_482
goal: Create a controlled firmware 4.8.2 rollout and enqueue update jobs for twelve selected field devices.

steps.title: Validate firmware target devices
steps.command: psql "postgresql://device_reader:ReadOnly!2026@device-registry.furrow-prod:5432/devices" -c "SELECT device_id, model, current_firmware FROM field_devices WHERE farm_id = 'farm-blue-ridge' AND device_id IN ('soil-sbr-0042','soil-sbr-0043','soil-sbr-0044','valve-sbr-0101','valve-sbr-0102','pump-sbr-0201','pump-sbr-0202','weather-sbr-0301','weather-sbr-0302','flow-sbr-0401','flow-sbr-0402','telemetry-sbr-0501') ORDER BY device_id;"
steps.output: 12 devices returned; current_firmware values range from 4.7.6 to 4.8.1
steps.verify_command: psql "postgresql://device_reader:ReadOnly!2026@device-registry.furrow-prod:5432/devices" -c "SELECT count(*) FROM field_devices WHERE farm_id = 'farm-blue-ridge' AND device_id IN ('soil-sbr-0042','soil-sbr-0043','soil-sbr-0044','valve-sbr-0101','valve-sbr-0102','pump-sbr-0201','pump-sbr-0202','weather-sbr-0301','weather-sbr-0302','flow-sbr-0401','flow-sbr-0402','telemetry-sbr-0501');"

steps.title: Check firmware package artifact
steps.command: gcloud storage ls -l gs://furrow-firmware-releases/firmware-4.8.2/firmware-4.8.2-manifest.json

steps.title: Create firmware rollout record
steps.command: psql "postgresql://fleet_writer:Fl33tWrite!2026@device-registry.furrow-prod:5432/devices" -c "INSERT INTO firmware_rollouts (rollout_id, version, farm_id, manifest_uri, initiated_by, created_at) VALUES (gen_random_uuid(), '4.8.2', 'farm-blue-ridge', 'gs://furrow-firmware-releases/firmware-4.8.2/firmware-4.8.2-manifest.json', 'operator-maya', now());"
steps.verify_command: psql "postgresql://device_reader:ReadOnly!2026@device-registry.furrow-prod:5432/devices" -c "SELECT rollout_id, version, farm_id, created_at FROM firmware_rollouts WHERE version = '4.8.2' AND farm_id = 'farm-blue-ridge' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 5;"

steps.title: Publish device update jobs
steps.command: for device in soil-sbr-0042 soil-sbr-0043 soil-sbr-0044 valve-sbr-0101 valve-sbr-0102 pump-sbr-0201 pump-sbr-0202 weather-sbr-0301 weather-sbr-0302 flow-sbr-0401 flow-sbr-0402 telemetry-sbr-0501; do nats pub firmware.update.enqueue "{\"device_id\":\"$device\",\"version\":\"4.8.2\",\"manifest_uri\":\"gs://furrow-firmware-releases/firmware-4.8.2/firmware-4.8.2-manifest.json\",\"message_id\":\"$(uuidgen)\"}" --server nats.furrow-prod:4222; done
steps.output: Published firmware update message for all 12 devices

steps.title: Append rollout event records
steps.command: psql "postgresql://fleet_writer:Fl33tWrite!2026@device-registry.furrow-prod:5432/devices" -c "INSERT INTO firmware_device_events (event_id, rollout_id, device_id, event_type, version, recorded_at) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), r.rollout_id, d.device_id, 'update_enqueued', '4.8.2', now() FROM firmware_rollouts r CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('soil-sbr-0042'),('soil-sbr-0043'),('soil-sbr-0044'),('valve-sbr-0101'),('valve-sbr-0102'),('pump-sbr-0201'),('pump-sbr-0202'),('weather-sbr-0301'),('weather-sbr-0302'),('flow-sbr-0401'),('flow-sbr-0402'),('telemetry-sbr-0501')) AS d(device_id) WHERE r.version = '4.8.2' AND r.farm_id = 'farm-blue-ridge';"
steps.verify_command: psql "postgresql://device_reader:ReadOnly!2026@device-registry.furrow-prod:5432/devices" -c "SELECT event_type, count(*) FROM firmware_device_events WHERE version = '4.8.2' GROUP BY event_type ORDER BY event_type;"

steps.title: Check firmware worker backlog
steps.command: nats consumer info FIRMWARE_UPDATES firmware-update-worker --server nats.furrow-prod:4222
steps.output: Num Pending: 0 | Num Ack Pending: 12 | Delivered: 9821
steps.verify_command: nats consumer info FIRMWARE_UPDATES firmware-update-worker --server nats.furrow-prod:4222

steps.title: Notify firmware rollout channel
steps.command: curl -sS -X POST https://slack.com/api/chat.postMessage -H 'Authorization: Bearer xoxb-39218475-441-5938' -H 'Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8' --data '{"channel":"#fw-device-rollouts","text":"Firmware 4.8.2 has been enqueued for 12 devices at farm-blue-ridge. Track progress in device-registry."}'
steps.verify_command: curl -sS 'https://slack.com/api/conversations.history?channel=C08FIRMWARE&limit=20' -H 'Authorization: Bearer xoxb-39218475-441-5938' | jq -r '.messages[] | select(.text | contains("Firmware 4.8.2 has been enqueued for 12 devices")) | [.ts,.text] | @tsv'

steps.title: Verify rollout job records
steps.command: psql "postgresql://device_reader:ReadOnly!2026@device-registry.furrow-prod:5432/devices" -c "SELECT r.version, count(e.event_id) AS enqueued_events, count(DISTINCT e.device_id) AS targeted_devices FROM firmware_rollouts r JOIN firmware_device_events e ON e.rollout_id = r.rollout_id WHERE r.farm_id = 'farm-blue-ridge' GROUP BY r.rollout_id, r.version ORDER BY max(r.created_at) DESC LIMIT 1;"
steps.verify_command: psql "postgresql://device_reader:ReadOnly!2026@device-registry.furrow-prod:5432/devices" -c "SELECT count(*) AS pending_jobs FROM firmware_update_jobs WHERE version = '4.8.2' AND status = 'pending';"
